source.file: S13-S14 question sheets and S17 user-supplied audio

provenance.method: Editorial bilingual questions about the same content distinctions as the supplied sheets. No transcript, scored answer key or reconstructed door verb is published. The native audio is the unchanged user-supplied file, named with its actual MP4 container extension.

items.maltese: 1. Fuq min kienet taħseb Tonina l-ħin kollu?
items.english: Who was Tonina thinking about all the time?
What did Tonina hear outside in the street?

items.maltese: 3. Minn fejn kienet tara x'kien qed jiġri?
items.english: From where could she see what was happening?
Why was she afraid of the police?
What did Tonina forget on the stove?
What smell did she notice near the kitchen?

items.maltese: 7. Għaliex ma kellhiex ikel x'tagħti lir-raġel tagħha?
items.english: Why did she have no food to give her husband?

items.maltese: 8. X'kielu Tonina u r-raġel tagħha dakinhar?
items.english: What did Tonina and her husband eat that day?
What did her husband tell her to do about the neighbours?
Did Tonina change her habit in the end?
